task.ques: Locate a pre-trained natural language processing model on Hugging Face that specializes in named entity recognition (NER), confirm that the model was last updated in 2024 and has 1M+ downloads.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: dslim/bert-base-NER satisfies the task: a pre-trained BERT model fine-tuned for named entity recognition (NER), last updated October 8, 2024, with 1,107,059 downloads last month (displayed as 1.11M in the listing).

The model card confirms that it is ready to use for NER and was fine-tuned on the English CoNLL-2003 dataset: https://huggingface.co/dslim/bert-base-NER
The filtered Hugging Face listing shows the model name, “Updated Oct 8, 2024,” and “1.11M” downloads together: https://huggingface.co/models?pipeline_tag=token-classification&sort=downloads&search=dslim%2Fbert-base-NER
Evidence screenshot: final.png (1280 × 723 viewport image).
